subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Climate Risk for Business
description: A quick, practical guide to Climate Risk for Business.

hook.text: Climate change will cost the global economy $23 trillion by 2050. It's not just environmental. It's financial.

buildup.text: Climate risk divides into physical risk (floods, fires, heat) and transition risk (policy changes, stranded assets).

discovery.text: The TCFD framework asks companies to disclose climate risks to investors — governance, strategy, metrics, and targets.

twist.text: Companies that ignore climate risk face both physical damage and regulatory penalties as disclosure becomes mandatory.

climax.text: Climate risk is financial risk. Every company must assess, disclose, and manage its exposure.

punchline.text: $23 trillion by 2050. Climate risk is financial risk.

quiz.question: What are the two types of climate risk?
options: Physical risk (floods, fires) and transition risk (policy changes)
